misc: Has planted his seeds in four different women in four different decades.
biography: Mikko stands as a remarkable and enduring presence within the illustrious chronicles of the Hector Trophée, having brought his exceptional golfing talents from the manicured fairways of Lakeside Golf Vammala to the esteemed pair competition across eleven distinct editions. Away from the pristine links, this dedicated competitor is known among his companions for an astonishingly vibrant personal legacy, having famously planted his seeds in four different women across four distinct decades with an effortless charm that matches his smooth swing on the course.

While victories of the coveted Hector Trophée and the individual acclaim of the Victor Trophy have thus far eluded Mikko across his eleven tournament appearances, his active participation in the vibrant community surrounding the event ensures that his compelling competitive journey remains fully open. Observers eagerly anticipate his next return to the fairways, knowing well that Mikko will unfailingly deliver a captivating masterclass in both sportsmanship and larger-than-life character.
